lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Oh— sorry, I didn't notice you.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: I was trying to solve this problem in my head.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: I got it right, but I feel like I got it right for the wrong reason.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: ...You passed and you're still stressed about it?

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: A correct answer you don't fully understand is just a lucky guess wearing a disguise.

lines.speaker: Kiko
lines.text: I wish I had your problems.

lines.speaker: Joshua
lines.text: Trust me, it keeps you up at night.
